messages_1:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Datacrest POC — acceptance metrics & initial plan

Hi Ayesha — great talking earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so the team is aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary (what we heard)
- Primary goal: replace extract + heuristics for support routing with an embeddings + reranker flow to cut routing errors by 30% and reduce manual triage.
- Key integrations: Zendesk (tickets), S3 for logs, and SSO for team access.
- Success window: 4 week POC with defined acceptance metrics.

Proposed acceptance criteria (please confirm):
1) Intent routing precision >= 0.75 on a 1k labelled sample provided by Datacrest.
2) Average inference p95 latency <= 300ms for 1-2k concurrent sessions.
3) End-to-end throughput to sustain peak ticket volume (approx 5k/day) with <10% tail errors.
4) No data retention of raw ticket text beyond the POC (customer-controlled retention policy).

POC timeline (draft)
- Week 0 (this week): access & data ingestion (Datacrest to provide sample export + access account).
- Week 1: baseline evaluation & model selection; Redwood to deliver baseline report.
- Week 2: integration + test harness; run initial scoring.
- Week 3: tuning + reranker; run gated acceptance tests.
- Week 4: final acceptance, handoff and lessons learned.

Owners (draft)
- Datacrest: provide labelled 1k sample, S3 access, and a staging Zendesk instance.
- Redwood: infra, model selection, run experiments, deliver metrics dashboard.

Attachments: I attached the Redwood POC template with sections for acceptance tests and data checklist (redwood-poc-template.pdf).

Immediate asks
- Ayesha: confirm acceptance criteria above and the person who will own the labelled sample delivery.
- Procurement (cc if needed): any specific compliance/process requirements for SSO/KMS we should surface early.

Ill turn this into a short execution sheet after your confirmation. Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference — production-first inference
